`/implement` Step 18a stall recovery has four public-boundary surfaces: the larch bug body (`bug-body`), the terminal failure comment (`bug-comment`), the `/larch:issue --input-file` wrapper (`issue-input-file`), and the consumer-repo chat print (`chat-print`). `skills/implement/scripts/stall-recovery-report-allowlists.tsv` is the mechanical allowlist for those surfaces; `skills/implement/scripts/stall-recovery-report.sh lint` verifies TSV, code, and `stall-recovery-report.md` parity.

Public fields are limited to closed classifier enums, numeric step/exit fields, a sanitized signature hash, attempt metadata fields (`class`, `signature`, `resume_hint`, `outcome`, `utc`), and fixed maintainer-controlled prose templates. All body/comment content is still piped through `scripts/redact-secrets.sh` as a secrets-family backstop.

`--failure-detail-log` is accepted only when the path is absolute, physically canonical, regular, non-symlink, under `$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR`, and at most 64 KiB. input.command:
IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=<TMPDIR>
CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=$(awk 'BEGIN{p="LARCH_CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="} index($0,p)==1{print substr($0,length(p)+1); exit}' "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" 2>/dev/null || true)
LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID --default "")
LARCH_CLAUDE_SOURCE_FILE=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key LARCH_CLAUDE_SOURCE_FILE --default "")
LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER=$("$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh" --file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" --key LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER --default "")
export LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID LARCH_CLAUDE_SOURCE_FILE LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT
export LARCH_QUIET_BREADCRUMBS=1

mkdir -p "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs"
_launch_id="ship-pr.$$"
export LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM="$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.ndjson"
: > "$LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM"
export LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL="$(mktemp "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.done.XXXXXX")"
export LARCH_STATUS_FILE="$(mktemp "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.status.XXXXXX")"
export LARCH_QUIET_LOG_FILE="$(mktemp "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.quiet.XXXXXX")"
export LARCH_BREADCRUMBS_SURFACED_FILE="$(mktemp "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.surfaced.XXXXXX")"
export LARCH_PAIRED_PID_FILE="$(mktemp "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.pid.XXXXXX")"
touch "$LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL" "$LARCH_BREADCRUMBS_SURFACED_FILE"

# Tool JSON: run_in_background: true
# Background pair required: see BASH_AUTHORING.md §4
"$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/ship-pr.sh" \
  --state-file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh" \
  --implement-tmpdir "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR" \
  --merge "true" \
  --draft "false" \
  --forked "false" \
  --branch-name "sergey-zhupanov/implementing-implement-when-it-detects-a-2957" \
  --expected-session-id "$(cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-id" 2>/dev/null || true)" \
  --expected-tmpdir-basename-prefix "claude-implement-larch3-" \
  --issue-number "2957" \
  --manifest-path "" \
  --run-id "3F3BE316-C6AF-4E48-9EBD-FEAF0FE31E69" \
  --tool-label "codex" \
  --no-admin-fallback "false" \
  --no-logs-commit "false" \
  --repo "character-ai/larch" &

"$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/breadcrumb-monitor.sh" \
  --stream "$LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM" \
  --done-sentinel "$LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL" \
  --status-file "$LARCH_STATUS_FILE" \
  --quiet-log "$LARCH_QUIET_LOG_FILE" \
  --surfaced-sentinel "$LARCH_BREADCRUMBS_SURFACED_FILE" \
  --paired-pid-file "$LARCH_PAIRED_PID_FILE"

IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=<TMPDIR>
sleep 60
echo "=== ship-pr progress ==="
cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr."*".quiet."* 2>/dev/null | tail -10
echo "==="
cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh" 2>/dev/null | grep "^PHASE="
